name: NCAB Group USA
old_description: Our ongoing goal is to make our customers more resilient, agile, and sustainable. We work with a global network of carefully selected partner factories and help our customers produce reliable printed circuit boards. Through our competence, delivery accuracy, and product quality, we take full responsibility for the PCB – from design to series production.
about: NCAB Group USA operates from Hampstead, New Hampshire, as the North American arm of a global PCB supplier founded in 1993. The company began as a Swedish venture and has grown into a network of 19 local companies across Europe, Asia, and North America, serving customers in roughly 45 countries. Ownership details are not disclosed in the source material, and no individual founders are named.
